name: anomalyguessr
description: Spot-the-anachronism game: find the one modern object an AI smuggled into a public-domain historical photo

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build index.html --outdir dist --target browser --minify --define 'process.env.NODE_ENV="production"' && cp -r scenes dist/scenes
scripts.checks: bun run format && concurrently -g -c auto 'bun run tsc' 'bun run biome' 'bun run knip' 'bun run test'
